rationale: Reactive current per sample uses iq = k*(deadband - V) = 2.0*(0.9 - V) when V < 0.9 pu, clipped at the 1.2 pu current limit. Active current retains prefault 0.92 pu but is reduced to the remaining apparent-current capability sqrt(1.2^2 - iq^2) when reactive priority would otherwise exceed the limit (at t160 iq=0.84 forces id=0.857 and total=1.2 pu). Minimum iq is 0.04 pu (t000) and maximum total current is 1.2 pu (t160). The voltage dips to 0.48 pu, staying above the 0.45 pu FRT floor, and the reactive-current requirement is met, but the low-voltage condition (V < 0.9 pu deadband) persists for the full 0.24 s window, exceeding max_low_voltage_duration_s = 0.2 s, so ride-through/FRT compliance fails.
